summary: Read the complete markdown, including all supplementary materials, and checked all 11 estimates against their cited PDF pages using PyMuPDF text and table extraction. The existing numeric statistics and counts match the printed similarity analyses; no numeric transcription error was found. Found 14 missing linguistic estimates: seven output attributes in each of the two comparisons explicitly reported in Tables 5 and 6. Their exclusion as non-randomized is not established by the paper's methods; retain the reported estimates with the inconsistent/unconfirmed analysis counts unresolved. Also found three se_basis coding errors: the Bayesian estimates report HDIs but have an unspecified analysis unit, which the current spec/codebook codes unclear rather than not_reported. The other checked outcome, timing, direction, arm, and design codes are consistent with the paper.
